This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Learned counsel for the State submitted that the notice on the informant has been made sufficient since 12.08.2023.
None appears on behalf of the informant.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the State.

This is an appeal under section 14-A of S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, 1989 in connection with Special G.R.
Case No.19 of 2023 arising out of Deogarh P.S. Case No.367 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Deogarh for // 2 // offences punishable under sections 376(1)/294/354-A of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3(1)(xii)/ 3(1)(w)(i)(ii)/3(2)(v) of the S.C.
& S.T. (PoA) Act.

sentences.text: 1 The appellant moved an application for bail before the Court of learned Sessions Judge, Deogarh which was rejected on 04.07.2023.

entities.text: Court of learned Sessions Judge, Deogarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in judicial custody since 02.06.2023 and he has been charge sheeted under sections 376(1)/294/354-A of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3(1)(xii)/ 3(1)(w)(i)(ii)/3(2)(v) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act and after going through the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim, who is aged about twenty two years placed by the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.

Let the appellant be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper subject to conditions that the appellant shall appear before the learned trial Court on each date when the case would be posted for trial and he shall not try to tamper with the evidence or try to come in contact with the victim.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
// 3 // The CRLA is accordingly disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge RKM Signed by: RABINDRA KUMAR MISHRA
